title: SkyBloke Texture Tweaks
description: Overlay resource pack meant as a dependency for a modpack
body:
Meant to be used with [SkyBloke](https://modrinth.com/modpack/skybloke). This resource pack affects things like font, gui, enchantment glint, menu backgrounds, and more. It replaces custom resources with vanilla ones. **Without SkyBloke, this resource pack won't appear to do anything.**

The font changes back to 16 bit. Game buttons return to normal.

![Example Font](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YcPSwpE0/images/4cbc7defc420d6d9e2a2f6211c64fb3eea091196.gif)

The inventory tabs become opaque. The equipment slots also regain visibility.

![Example Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YcPSwpE0/images/6efc6db3f4952bcd0996e28c017a4d41c4f0ae34.gif)
